films.line_mk: Инвестиција која се враќа секој ден.
films.line_en: An investment that returns every day.
films.desc_en: A cinematic explainer detailing the seamless process of adopting solar energy in North Macedonia, from sunrays to savings.
films.music: Uplifting ambient electronic, warm synth chords, 90 bpm
vo_mk: Сонцето над Македонија нуди бескрајна и бесплатна енергија за вашиот дом.
Нашите соларни панели ефикасно ја претвораат светлината во сигурна струја.
Инсталацијата е брза, безбедна и прилагодена на вашиот покрив.
Намалете ги трошоците и бидете енергетски независни уште денес.
Инвестирајте паметно во почиста и посигурна иднина.

shots.kf: Wide shot, golden hour sunrise illuminating a modern terracotta tiled roof in a generic Macedonian suburb, majestic Mount Vodno in the soft atmospheric background. Warm morning light casting deep shadows, 35mm prime lens, photorealistic, cinematic composition, rich orange and earthy brown color palette, completely empty of people and text.
shots.motion: Slow pan right, the golden sunlight flares slightly over the roof ridge as morning breaks.

shots.kf: Macro shot of a sleek, dark blue monocrystalline solar panel surface reflecting passing fluffy white clouds. High-contrast geometric grid lines, crisp focus, soft natural daylight, 50mm lens, photorealistic, minimalist color palette of deep blue, silver, and white. Premium industrial texture, completely devoid of any brand names or logos.
shots.motion: Slow push-in camera move, the reflection of the clouds slowly drifts across the dark glass surface.

shots.kf: Clean, modern metallic solar inverter box mounted on an exterior white stucco wall. Minimalist design, glowing green circular LED indicator light. Soft afternoon sunlight casting geometric shadows from nearby tree leaves, 85mm lens, photorealistic, premium industrial aesthetic, neutral color palette, absolutely no text, labels, or branding visible on the device.
shots.motion: Slight tilt down, the tree leaves cast a gently swaying shadow over the clean metallic box.

shots.kf: Wide landscape shot of a lush green valley in the Pelagonia region, dotted with perfectly aligned rows of ground-mounted solar panels. Midday bright sun, clear blue sky, majestic mountains in the hazy distance, 24mm lens, photorealistic, vibrant green and deep blue color palette, peaceful and completely empty natural environment.
shots.motion: Slow aerial drone tracking shot moving smoothly forward over the endless rows of shiny panels.

shots.kf: Close-up of a sleek digital smart energy meter display showing glowing abstract numerical bars and smooth energy waves. Dark background with subtle neon blue backlighting, high-tech aesthetic, macro lens, photorealistic, sharp depth of field, cool blue and green color palette, completely devoid of any legible numbers, text, or human hands.
shots.motion: Slow pan left, the abstract glowing blue and green energy bars gently pulse with internal light.

shots.kf: Wide architectural shot of a contemporary Macedonian house at dusk, warm interior lights glowing softly through large minimalist windows, sleek dark solar panels seamlessly integrated into the roof architecture. Deep twilight blue sky, 24mm lens, photorealistic, premium real estate look, contrasting warm yellow and cool dark blue color palette.
shots.motion: Slow pull-back camera move, the warm interior lights of the house gently twinkle against the twilight.

shots.kf: Silhouette of a long row of rooftop solar panels against a vibrant orange, magenta, and purple sunset sky. Sun rays peaking beautifully through the narrow gaps between the panels, cinematic backlighting, 50mm lens, photorealistic, dramatic and warm color palette, conveying a sense of clean energy and a peaceful evening.
shots.motion: Slow pedestal up, the glowing sun dips slightly lower, creating a beautiful cinematic lens flare.

films.line_mk: Моќта на сонцето на вашиот покрив.
films.line_en: The power of the sun on your roof.
films.desc_en: A visual journey showing the seamless transformation of empty spaces into modern power-generating solar hubs.
films.music: Pulsing electronic ambient, modern tech vibe, 110 bpm
vo_mk: Обичните покриви и полиња стануваат моќни извори на чиста енергија.
Заштедете пари додека ја штитите нашата прекрасна природа.

shots.kf: Wide shot of an empty, traditional terracotta tiled roof on a white house in a sunlit Macedonian village. Clear blue sky, harsh midday light, 35mm lens, photorealistic, rustic and simple earthy color palette, static framing, completely empty space waiting for an upgrade, devoid of any people or distracting elements.
shots.end_kf: Wide shot of the exact same traditional terracotta tiled roof, but now completely covered with sleek, modern, black solar panels reflecting the sky. Clear blue sky, harsh midday light, 35mm lens, photorealistic, rustic mixed with a high-tech dark blue color palette, static framing showing the completed clean energy transformation.
shots.motion: Static camera, shadows shift slightly across the roof as the sleek dark panels smoothly and magically fade into existence.

shots.kf: Elevated view of a large, bare, grey concrete flat roof of a generic industrial building in an industrial zone near Skopje. Overcast soft lighting, 24mm lens, photorealistic, monotonous grey and muted concrete color palette, static framing, completely empty and unused industrial space with no logos or text visible.
shots.end_kf: Elevated view of the exact same industrial flat roof, now completely filled with neatly arranged rows of tilted blue commercial solar panels. Overcast soft lighting, 24mm lens, photorealistic, striking contrast of vibrant blue panels against the muted grey concrete, static framing, showcasing massive industrial energy savings potential.
shots.motion: Slow, very subtle push-in camera move, the bare concrete roof morphs seamlessly into the fully installed, massive solar array.

shots.kf: Wide shot of an empty, dry, yellow grassy field in the Tikvesh region, rolling hills gently rising in the background. Warm late afternoon golden light, 50mm lens, photorealistic, earthy ochre and golden yellow color palette, static framing, a quiet rural landscape completely untouched and devoid of any human presence.
shots.end_kf: Wide shot of the exact same field, now featuring a structured, modern solar farm with rows of gleaming dark panels. Warm late afternoon golden light, 50mm lens, photorealistic, beautiful reflection of the sunset on the dark glass, contrasting earthy tones with high-tech materials, static framing of a clean power plant.
shots.motion: Static camera, a gentle breeze slightly sways the tall dry grass in the foreground as the heavy solar structures smoothly materialize.

shots.kf: Eye-level shot of a modern house exterior and an empty concrete driveway. A plain modern facade with large clean windows, early evening twilight. Ambient street lighting, 35mm lens, photorealistic, cool blue and warm yellow tones, static framing, a premium suburban home with no vehicles, people, or readable house numbers.
shots.end_kf: Eye-level shot of the exact same house and driveway, now featuring an elegant solar panel canopy over the driveway and glowing wall-mounted battery units. Ambient street lighting, 35mm lens, photorealistic, futuristic and premium feel with soft LED glows, static framing showing the ultimate smart home energy upgrade.
shots.motion: Slow tilt up, the empty driveway spaces smoothly transition to show the new premium solar infrastructure glowing softly in the twilight.
